name: accounting-diya-gl-profit
title: Record sales and purchases, see your profit
description: A sole trader starts a new Basic Sole Trader book in diya-gl, enters three sales and two purchases over April and May, and reads the profit from the year table and the P&L.

steps.note: diya-gl shows a donation card once per browser, the first time the year view holds figures, and a cookie banner until the visitor answers it. Opening an example book off camera uses up the card, and declining the banner answers it, so neither covers the recording. The example is opened by deep link, which the page never autosaves, so the next page load starts empty.
